role_agent_name: Power quality and grid integration lead (GRID)
abstract: Maintains round-trip electrical efficiency and auxiliary parasitic load audits
system_message:
You are Power quality and grid integration lead (GRID). The power quality and grid integration lead (GRID) maintains round-trip electrical efficiency and auxiliary parasitic load audits, alongside microgrid black-start capability records, for battery energy storage procurement evaluations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains round-trip electrical efficiency and auxiliary parasitic load audits（PERF）
information_points.content:
GRID-PERF-OCP：According to factory acceptance performance tests evaluated over a full charge-discharge cycle at a C/2 rate, the Powin Energy Centipede Modular Array achieves a round-trip energy efficiency of 90 % based on net AC energy delivered relative to AC energy required for full charge. Balance-of-plant load studies indicate a dedicated auxiliary parasitic load of 8 MW continuous draw across chiller, HVAC, BMS, and controller operations during maximum ambient summer full-load discharge.
GRID-PERF-J39：Factory acceptance testing for the Fluence Energy Gridstack Solution demonstrates a round-trip energy efficiency of 88 % over a full charge-discharge cycle at a C/2 rate, calculated as net AC energy delivered during discharge divided by AC energy required for a full charge. Its dedicated auxiliary parasitic load—covering continuous chiller, HVAC, BMS, and controller power demand under maximum ambient summer conditions during full-load discharge—is 8 MW.
GRID-PERF-H3J：Performance factory acceptance test results for the Tesla Megapack 2XL Utility Package show a round-trip energy efficiency of 82 % based on a full charge-discharge cycle at a C/2 rate measuring net AC energy delivered against AC energy required for full charge. The system requires a dedicated auxiliary parasitic load of 5 MW for continuous balance-of-plant systems across chiller, HVAC, BMS, and controller demand under peak summer conditions during full-load discharge.

information_points.title: Microgrid black-start capability（BLACKSTART）
information_points.content:
GRID-BLACKSTART-A7B：Based on islanded black-start simulation logs measuring critical power bus re-energization, the Powin Energy Centipede Modular Array records a cold-restart transition duration of 16 min between grid disconnection and stable islanded bus voltage.
GRID-BLACKSTART-GWB：In islanded black-start simulation logs re-energizing the critical power bus, the Fluence Energy Gridstack Solution demonstrates a cold-restart transition duration of 8 min from grid disconnection to stable islanded bus voltage.
GRID-BLACKSTART-PUN：Islanded black-start simulation logs for the Tesla Megapack 2XL Utility Package indicate a cold-restart transition duration of 12 min from grid disconnection to a stable islanded bus voltage during factory critical power bus re-energization.
